support_spans: new deep itching and creeping sensations in her bilateral shoulders and arms, worse at rest, partially relieved by movement, and predominantly occurring in the evening
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of deep itching and creeping sensations, worsened by rest and improved by movement, are characteristic of Restless Legs Syndrome.

candidates.name: Serotonin Syndrome
support_spans: She was receiving escitalopram 10 mg/d, duloxetine 80 mg/d, and clonazepam 1.5 mg/d
candidates.why: The patient's combination of medications, including escitalopram and duloxetine, which both affect serotonin levels, could contribute to the development of Serotonin Syndrome.

candidates.name: Dopamine Dysregulation Syndrome
support_spans: She had two severe episodes responsive to escitalopram (up to 20 mg/d) and duloxetine (up to 60 mg/d)
candidates.why: The patient's history of responsiveness to certain medications and her current symptoms could be related to Dopamine Dysregulation Syndrome, which involves an imbalance of dopamine in the brain.

candidates.name: Iron Deficiency Anemia
candidates.why: A definitive diagnosis of Iron Deficiency Anemia would require laboratory tests, such as a complete blood count (CBC) and iron level measurements.

candidates.name: Hypothyroidism
